## Historical audit: S0248

**Source:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_v2_4/audit_sources/raw_failures/scene_rsi_v2_1/r2/scene_rsi_v2_1/C1/selection/commons_194983350/trajectory.jsonl`. References below are JSONL lines and character ranges in this file.

| Evidence | Observation and interpretation |
|---|---|
| Student request, line 1 [0,8421) | The explicit goal was to reconstruct an indoor photograph as separate 3D meshes, matching camera and framing. The image itself is not visible in this audit; the student’s café interpretation is not independent verification. |
| Student response, line 3 [0,11801); execute step 1, line 4 [0,12455) | The student produced and submitted a nonempty program with named assets for architecture, ceiling, shelving, plants, banquette, table, chairs and cabinet. Its inventory described estimated bounds and occlusions. This establishes intended multiple objects, not their successful realization or visual accuracy. |
| Same response | The code specifies colored materials, translucent glassware, primitive wood-grain strips and ceiling pigment shapes; it does not establish that these textures or finishes matched the photograph. Chair panels, legs and piping, plant stems and leaves, and furniture components were positioned as parts, but their actual connections are unverified. The chair’s orientation and furniture placement were programmed; pose and overlap accuracy remain unknown. |
| Same response | The program sets a camera, world, three area lights, Cycles and 32 samples. These are attempted settings, not evidence of correct framing, illumination or a completed render. |
| Execution result, line 5 [0,1099) | Step 1 timed out after approximately 472.5 seconds, with empty stdout/stderr and no image. The trace contains no successful build, visual comparison, correction or final submission confirmation. The immediate outcome is a **technical interruption**, with reconstruction correctness unknown—not a demonstrated geometric or algorithmic failure. |
| Student session, line 2 [0,2879); complete supplied trace | The first session reports zero tool calls. The program itself is the visible autonomous construction; no iterative exploration is evidenced. No teacher input, diagnosis, proposed update or adoption appears in the trace. Availability of general instructions in line 1 is not teacher feedback or evidence of receipt of a separate intervention. |

**Lessons and uncertainty.** Transferably, a nonempty, detailed scene program is not equivalent to a rendered or visually validated scene; execution time must be distinguished from image mismatch. Task-specific hypotheses include whether the many repeated ceiling and plant primitives contributed to the timeout, and whether the camera, lighting, part connections or material choices would match the reference. The empty logs and absent render do not establish any of those causes or outcomes. No unseen image or later execution is assumed.
